summary: Pinnacle Food Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about its subsidiary PFHK signing a non-binding MOU to explore establishing an Open Yeast Platform hub at the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park. The MOU involves Open Yeast Collection and Bioboost Synbio Consulting, aiming to localize yeast DNA parts and strains for synthetic biology research under an OpenMTA framework. The press release is forward-looking with no definitive agreement, price, stake, or binding commitment. No special-situation event such as acquisition, activist campaign, restructuring, or capital return is present. This is a routine business development announcement, equivalent to a press release furnished to the SEC under cover of Form 6-K.
